_doc: Legacy quirks knowledge base: peculiarities of the frozen legacy game that the port must reproduce (or that explain a divergence). Surfaced by `pnpm map <term>` and `pnpm rca`/`investigate` (matched on tags). Add an entry for EVERY confirmed cause (pnpm parity keep --cause ... does it). `port` files must exist (tests/ledger.test.ts). Never delete: mark `superseded` instead.

quirks.rule: The Doppelganger calls shot/heavy with cloneOf(p): a BARE object {x,y,id,aim,buff,power,focus,mvName,shotT} at the mirrored spot. Every other p.<field> reads undefined (cooldowns unset, season 0, no Trinity, no Double Mice, no nD) and writes are lost. Heavies repeat from the mirror at 0.7x; entity heavies call myE(p,..) so they can kill the REAL caster's entities (Flandre Laevatein replaced).
quirks.tool: pnpm spec standin lists the fields per character

quirks.rule: legacy p.mvName keeps the LAST started move name after the move ends (p.mv is the current move). Code reading mvName (Nazrin onHit steal 'lunge') sees stale values. Port: s.mvLast (set in atkstart), not s.mvId.
The outermost hit() wrapper calls character onHit whenever the victim's hp dropped, on ANY path (spell-chip included), not only the main damage path.

Legacy layers behaviour by redefining functions: later definitions are OUTER. Damage factors apply one wrapper at a time, outermost first; float association matters at the last bit (vx*=n/l vs vx*n/l). Verify with bit-exact drift probes (pnpm parity replay).
Legacy overrides Math.sin/cos/atan/atan2/hypot/log/exp/pow with its own deterministic series; sim.math is an EXACT port (bit-identical, tests/math-legacy.test.ts). Never target V8.

The game frame gf does not advance during hit-stop. Diff messages ('okina/hecatia f1906 ...') use the LEGACY gf; the report's `frame` and `pnpm rca` use the loop frame (can be 40+ larger). Legacy `frame` in rca setter logs is gf.
Check the legacy line before choosing: some places use bodyR(q) (giant/tiny aware: Marisa comet trail), others the raw T.BODY_R (cards, clone, melee, bombs, blade).

Clash excludes moves with spd; heavy sweep skips fake/breaker bullets; spell heavies are breakers when the caster holds Parry; stun-repeat reduction is keyed by hit-data object identity; behaviour-kind closures follow the ORIGINAL caster (bcast).

Legacy has element auras and reactions (xReact/rx(a,b,..)); NOT ported. The oracle deletes RX (ledger:elements-reactions). Divergences in hecatia/okina/flandre games with burn/freeze items may be this.
Legacy render uses Math.random for cosmetics; the harness seeds it so frames are reproducible (tools/parity/legacy.cjs).

Spells that call legacy addB (Nue/Okina/Hecatia/Flandre pools) spawn 14px ahead of the caster with NO map-bounds check; the port used sB which refuses outside the map. Visible when Warp lets a player stand at the edge.

Doppelganger soak ran before bullet motion in the port; legacy runs it after motion+acc clamp and before chStep bullet mods, so a soaked bullet never gets acc +5% (and is tested at its post-motion position)

Every legacy step wrapper (clone soak, bumpers, freeze queue, The World knives) runs AFTER the base step incl. bullet motion; the port ran item-late BEFORE motion, so the shared rng stream was drawn in another order (knife angles vs dollH fn callback)
KO beam direction used a 1e-9 tolerance on p.vx; legacy is p.vx||p.kbx (only exact 0 falls back), so a 3e-12 friction residue still picks the direction
